screen.title: Look
screen.text: SETTINGS Look Change how OSL appears on this device. These choices never affect messages or other people. Mode Choose the base brightness. Light A bright OSL window. Dark A dark OSL window. Computer Follow computer setting. Named looks Start with a ready-made palette. Midnight Deep blue for low-light work. Paper Warm white, soft contrast. Signal Cool charcoal, crisp accent. Accent Use this color for selected controls. Cyan Clear blue emphasis. Violet Soft purple emphasis. Amber Warm gold emphasis. Corners and glow Set the edge shape and highlight. CORNERS Square Sharp edges. Soft Rounded edges. GLOW Off No colored halo. On Subtle accent halo. Text and spacing Make reading more comfortable. TEXT Comfortable Standard size. Large Larger text. SPACING Compact Controls closer. Relaxed More room. Reset look Return every look choice to OSL’s defaults. Reset
